name: Lilian☆Night Succubus no Senzoku Keiyaku
original_name: リリアン☆ナイト サキュバスの専属契約
source:
As I lay in bed, ready to start my nightly routine, a girl appeared out of nowhere, right in front of me! I said "girl", but she had wings and horns - not to mention she could fly! I'm pretty sure she's not human... I mean, she drank a load of my cum, calling it a taste test! Apparently, she liked it enough to offer for us to form a "contract". Uhh... I'm not entirely sure what I'm supposed to do here...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793800]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当我躺在床上，准备开始我的夜间例行公事时，一个女孩突然出现在我面前！我说“女孩”，但她有翅膀和角——更不用说她会飞！我很确定她不是人类……我的意思是，她喝了我的大量精液，称之为味觉测试！显然，她很乐意与我们签订一份“合同”。呃…我不完全确定我应该在这里做什么…
